title: Bridge the maintenance gap
creator: Electrify examples
description: Prepare the Manassas grid for an overhaul of its original gas peaker. Pay for a shorter outage or accept support for the longer schedule, then keep customers supplied without a bill shock.

scenario.endMessage: The original gas peaker is back online. Review the cost of the overhaul and the service your customers received.

items.label: Keep the city supplied through maintenance
Keep billed electricity at or below 13 cents

events.title: Gas peaker overhaul
events.message: The original gas peaker is offline for 3 months.
events.preview: The original gas peaker will be offline for 3 months from month 13.
events.endMessage: The original gas peaker overhaul is complete.

events.title: Gas peaker overhaul
events.message: The original gas peaker is offline for 6 months.
events.preview: The original gas peaker will be offline for 6 months from month 13.
events.endMessage: The original gas peaker overhaul is complete.

choices.title: Choose the overhaul schedule
choices.prompt: Pay for a three-month outage or accept a grant for a six-month outage. The original gas peaker stops generating in month 13; new plants remain available.

options.label: Accelerate the overhaul
options.description: Pay 3,000,000 starting-year dollars to finish the original gas peaker overhaul in three months.
options.message: Your company paid for the three-month overhaul.

options.label: Accept standard-schedule support
options.description: Receive 2,000,000 starting-year dollars; the original gas peaker overhaul takes six months.
options.message: Your company accepted support for the six-month overhaul.
